ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patches on the distal outer lobes; dense white speckling and mottling concentrated in the lower central regions; solid black pigmentation along the peduncle junction and upper trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and symmetrical inward slopes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with variable pixel-amplitude; more pronounced jagged peaks visible on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curve originating from the median notch and tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips and along portions of the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned vertical and diagonal white linear markings (rake marks) interrupting the dark pigmentation on the central and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive ectoparasitic barnacle colonization at the tips of both lobes; multiple linear rake-mark scars visible across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct small circular white-rimmed dark spot (ocellus) located in the inner-center region of the left lobe's dark pigmentation.
